ticker_news.title: Should You Buy AMD Stock on the Dip?
ticker_news.description: AMD's AI business is thriving, but other segments continue to weigh on the company's growth, leading to a nearly 8% drop in stock price.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

ticker_news.title: 4 Top Stocks to Buy in November
ticker_news.description: The article discusses four stocks that the author is looking to buy in November, including Alphabet (GOOGL). The author believes the market could finish the year higher than where it is currently.
ticker_news.author: Mark Roussin, Cpa

SPY.title: Stocks Rebound After Selloff As October Hiring Slump Fuels Interest Rate Cut Bets: 10 ETFs To Watch Friday
SPY.description: Stocks rebounded after Thursday's decline as a hiring freeze in October boosted market expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, and other sector-specific ETFs saw gains.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari, Benzinga Staff Writer
